artworks.title: Gathering Fruit
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: A woman standing on a ladder propped against a wall hands fruit down to a nude child held by a second woman in this vertical, partially colored print. The scene is printed with areas of mostly flat color in shades of vivid green and pastel peach and pink. The women and child have peachy-toned skin and brown hair. Both women wear long-skirted dresses with long, loose sleeves, and their hair is pulled back in buns at the napes of their necks. The ladder, to our left, leans against the verdant green vines and yellow fruit growing up a wall, which itself is the color of the cream-white paper. The woman standing on the ladder wears a pale, frost-green dress with a white kerchief at her neck. She looks down in profile at the child to our right. The child sits facing away from us in the other woman’s arms, bare buns squished along one forearm. The child reaches for the fruit, perhaps a cluster of small grapes. The second woman wears blush pink, and her face is hidden by the child’s head. An opening in the wall to the right leads back to an open space with more greenery.

artworks.title: Gathering Fruit
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: A woman standing on a ladder propped against a wall hands fruit down to a nude child held by a second woman in this vertical colored print. The scene is printed with areas of mostly flat color in shades of vivid green, earthy browns, and pastel pinks and blue. The women and child have peachy-toned skin and brown hair. Both women wear long, floral-patterned dresses with long, loose sleeves, and their hair is pulled back in buns at the napes of their necks. The ladder, to our left, leans against the verdant green vines growing up the brown wall. The woman standing on the ladder wears a powder-blue dress over an apricot-orange and white patterned kerchief around her neck. She looks down in profile at the child to our right. The child sits facing away from us in the other woman’s arms, bare buns squished along one forearm. The child reaches for the fruit, perhaps a cluster of small grapes. The second woman wears rose pink, and her face is hidden by the child’s head. An opening in the wall to the right leads back to an open space with more greenery. The sky above is a strip of topaz blue along the top edge of the print.

artworks.title: The Coiffure
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: A pale-skinned woman, nude from the waist up, gathers her hair in her raised hands as she sits before a mirror in this vertical, colored print. The large mirror is to our right, and the woman’s body is mostly turned away from us. Her head is bowed but a loose tendril of brown hair hanging beside one cheek is reflected in the mirror. Her lower body is wrapped in a voluminous off-white cloth as she leans forward on a curved terracotta-red and white striped armchair. Her facial features, the contours of her body, and the folds of the towel are all delineated with thin strokes of tawny brown. The mirror is set into a tan wall, and the wall beyond and carpet below her covered with abstract floral patterns. The wall has a dusty-rose motif over an off-white background with washes of light gray while the carpet pattern is tan over a peach background. The wall and chair are reflected in the mirror in paler tones.

artworks.title: Mother's Kiss
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows an adult and an infant in a relaxed, intimate pose. The adult on the left holds the infant, with their heads close together. The adult appears to be kissing or nuzzling the child's face. The adult has styled hair in an updo and wears a floral-patterned garment. The unclothed infant is nestled against the adult's chest, with short dark hair. There are no visible accessories or jewelry. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Bath
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: A woman kneels to test the water in a freestanding bathtub with one hand as she braces a nude child against her knee with the other in this vertical, colored print. The people and objects are outlined lightly with brown for the bodies and black for the woman’s clothing. Both the woman and baby’s hair are incised with delicate black lines. The woman’s hair is pulled back from a high forehead, and she has a straight nose, pursed lips, and a slight double chin. Her long-sleeved, floor-length dress has a narrow collar and is pleated across the chest and at the cuff we can see. The dress is filled in with a field of bright lemon yellow and patterned with a floral design. The baby turns toward the woman’s body and hangs their arms over her bracing hand. The baby has short, wispy, black hair with delicate facial features, a rotund belly, and satisfyingly pudgy rolls on the legs. The tub and lines indicating water are indigo blue. There are some smudges across the paper, especially at the edges.

artworks.title: Maternal Caress
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting in an upholstered chair and tightly hugging a nude, blond child in this vertical, colored print. Both have pale, peach-toned skin. The woman’s black hair is pulled back though a couple tendrils curl on her forehead. Her eyes are downcast and her pink lips parted. She wears a long, cream-white dress dotted with blush-pink, petal-like forms. One arm is under the baby’s chubby bottom and the other braces the child behind the shoulders. The baby wraps their arms around the woman’s neck so they are cheek to cheek. The chair sits in front of a bed with a boxy frame and a pillowy pale blue mattress. The upholstery on the woman’s chair and the wallpaper behind her are patterned with dusky rose-pink flowers and vines against very pale yellow. The floor is also dark rose pink.

artworks.title: The Lamp
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated, with her upper body turned slightly away from the viewer. She has short brown hair, a prominent nose, and slightly pursed lips. She is wearing a pale yellow sleeveless dress and holding a fan in her left hand. A dark green table in front of her holds a pink decorative container, papers, a cup, and a saucer. In the background, there is a large blue lamp with a pink shade, and the wall behind her has a horizontal line detail design.

artworks.title: The Letter
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting at a writing desk as she licks an envelope in this vertical, color print. A table folds down or extends from a tall secretary desk to our right. The blotter on the table and the woman’s long dress are both royal blue. The dress has a vaguely floral pattern in the cream-white of the paper, and the jacket is open to reveal a vertically pleated, pale pink shirt beneath. The woman’s skin is also the color of the paper. Her black hair is pulled back over dark brows and a delicate nose. She holds the open flap of the envelope to her mouth with both hands. A piece of white paper lies on the desktop in front of her. She sits in a brown chair, and the wallpaper of the room is patterned with green leaves and muted pink flowers against a white background. The artist signed the work with her initials in graphite in the bottom left, “MC.”

artworks.title: In the Omnibus
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: Two women, one holding a baby on her lap, sit on the long bench seat of an omnibus in this vertical, colored print. The women and their full skirts take up almost the width of the composition against the peacock-blue bench, which extends off both sides. The women and baby’s skin are the color of the cream-white paper. The woman to our left wears a tan-colored, high-collared dress, gloves, and hat. She looks off to our right, almost in profile. She has a round face and the hint of a double chin. One gloved hand rests on a cane. The other woman holds the baby and tips her head down toward the child. That second woman wears a tea rose-pink dress and a hat with areas of darker pink, fern green, and straw yellow. Both women’s black hair is pulled up under their hats. The baby’s ruffled white bonnet, blousy garment, stockings, and shoes are also the white of the paper, though the hair is picked out with yellow, the lips with pink, and the ball held in one hand with brown. The structure of the women’s bodices, puffy long sleeves, and long skirts as well as the baby’s clothing are outlined in black. A row of windows behind them, parallel to the top of the bench, open onto an arched bridge spanning a river with boats. To our left, the water’s edge is lined with spruce green trees. Back inside, the panel behind the women’s legs is peanut brown, and the top of the omnibus is muted mauve purple. The artist signed the work with her initials in graphite in the bottom left, “MC.”

artworks.title: Quietude
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a woman holding a small child in her arms. Both are depicted from the waist up. The woman is seated and leaning slightly forward, cradling the child who rests against her chest with one arm around her neck. She has her hair pulled back and tied neatly, revealing her facial profile with closed eyes. The woman wears a long-sleeved garment patterned with small shapes. The child, with short hair and a soft expression, is shown without clothing, curled in the woman's lap. The background is a simple, plain surface without additional objects, emphasizing the figures and their interaction.

artworks.title: Reine and Margot Seated on a Sofa (No. 2)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman with a young girl on her lap. The woman is seated, leaning slightly forward with her head tilted down towards the girl. Her facial features are soft, with closed eyes and a slight smile. Her hair is styled in a neat updo and she is wearing a simple, long-sleeved garment. The child is cradled in her arms, gazing up at the woman's face. The girl's hair is short and straight, falling just below her ears, and she wears a short-sleeved dress. The background is minimal and abstract, with just a few lines suggesting the outline of a window or a wall.

artworks.title: The Crocheting Lesson
artworks.medium: drypoint on light blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, holding a piece of cloth, and a child leaning against her. The woman has dark, pinned-up hair and a serene expression, while the child has short dark hair and eyes closed. Both are wearing simple clothing.

artworks.title: Repose
artworks.description: The image shows an adult sitting with a child on her lap. Both figures are positioned centrally in the frame. The adult, a woman, has her hair styled back and features a solemn expression. The child has short hair and is looking towards the left. The woman is wearing a long-sleeved dress with a small pattern, while the child is dressed in a sleeveless garment. They are sitting in front of a plain background with vertical panel lines. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects. The artwork is a sketch with minimalist, monochromatic lines providing detail and shading.

artworks.title: Margot in a Floppy Bonnet Leaning against a Chair
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait sketch of a young girl's upper body. She is seated with her body slightly angled to the right, one hand resting on her lap or an armrest. The girl has soft facial features, a slightly tilted head, looking directly at the viewer. Her hair is styled back with loose strands framing her face. She is wearing a soft head covering and a garment with layered fabric around her shoulders and arms. Her hand is delicately sketched near the bottom right of the image. The background is lightly sketched, fading into indistinct lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Bathers (Large Plate)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with nude figures in a landscape. The composition shows human forms in a natural setting with trees and large rock formations or hills in the background. The figures are depicted engaging with their environment, with two standing and one reclining on the ground. The background features a mountainous landscape under a clouded sky, framing the figures. The style is sketch-like, with visible pencil strokes creating movement and fluidity within the composition.

artworks.title: The Bathers (Small Plate)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures near a tree and a pool of water. The scene is set in an outdoor environment where several nude figures are depicted interacting with each other near the edge of a water body. The figures are sketched with fluid lines, capturing a sense of movement and leisure. The background shows elements of nature, such as a tree and patches of grass, depicted in soft, impressionistic strokes. The use of color is subtle and blends light shades of blue, green, and yellow, enhancing the relaxed and naturalistic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin
artworks.artist: Juste Chevillet after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person with defined facial features and a gentle expression. They wear spectacles and a fabric headpiece, and are dressed in a coat with a scarf or cravat. The background is plain and dark, with a decorative border featuring ornate designs and an inscription with the name "Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin" and other text below the portrait.

artworks.title: The Blind Beggar
artworks.artist: Pierre Louis de Surugue after Jean Siméon Chardin
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright and facing left. He has distinct facial features such as a long nose and a round chin, closed eyes, and short, wavy hair under a floppy hat. He wears a long robe, a scarf or collar around his neck, is holding a walking stick in his right hand, and a small metal cup in his left. A leash extends from his right hand to a small dog at his feet. The background features a stone wall with shadows and a wooden chair with a woven seat to the right. The overall setting appears to be an exterior space, perhaps a street or courtyard against a building wall.

artworks.title: Ecole du balayeur
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals standing closely together. They are wearing heavy, warm clothing such as coats, shawls, and hats. Most have facial hair and are wearing bulky shoes or boots. Some individuals are holding brooms or shovels. In the background, there are additional figures holding similar tools.

artworks.title: Infanterie legère française, Voltigeur
artworks.description: The image depicts a soldier standing in a snowy setting. He is turned slightly to the right, with his left hand on a downward-pointing rifle touching the ground. The soldier has a mustache and a determined expression, wearing a detailed military uniform with a feathered hat and a sash. He carries a circular backpack and wears protective gear. In the background, other soldiers march with rifles. Snow has fallen, leaving footprints and debris on the ground.

artworks.title: Infanterie legère française, Carabinier
artworks.description: The image depicts a soldier standing upright with a rifle in their left hand, dressed in a military uniform with a fur hat covering their head and a group of soldiers in similar attire standing behind them. The background shows a cloudy sky, a distant settlement on the left, and rocky terrain underfoot.

artworks.title: L'Aumône
artworks.description: The image includes four figures: three seated and one standing. The standing figure is a man in a military uniform with a bicorne hat. His face is partially covered but his nose and chin are visible. He is looking at something in his hand. The seated group consists of an old man holding a crutch, a boy, and another youth. The old man has long side hair and the boy has short hair. Another youth with short hair is seated on the ground. The old man gently holds the boy's hand. A hat is on the ground near the seated figures. The background shows a brick wall with climbing plants, set in a leafy environment.

artworks.title: Femmes Mauresques de Constantine
artworks.description: The image shows two people seated together, from head to mid-calf. The person on the left is cross-legged, facing slightly towards the right. They have dark hair covered by a turban. The person on the right is reclining with one arm resting on a gazelle or similar animal. Both individuals have delicate facial features and are dressed in ornate garments. They are seated on a textured fabric, with subtle, indistinct patterns in the background.

artworks.title: Venus Anadyomene
artworks.description: The image displays a full body view of a nude female figure standing on a rocky shoreline. She has a graceful posture with one bent leg and one straight leg. She is lifting her long hair with both hands. The background includes rocky outcrops, seashells, a calm sea, hills or mountains, cloudy sky, and a monochrome color scheme.
